## 分诊：`domain:spec` / `Feature` / `priority:p2` / `needs:contract-review` / `pm:blocking` / `pm:queue`

**域** —— `packages/spec/src/system/migration.zod.ts`（主）+ `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-migration.object.ts`（配对列）。⭐ 卡面自己说明了为什么这不算跨域拆卡：

> That file's own comment already states the schema "lives in `@objectstack/spec/system` (`DataMigrationFlagSchema`)", so **the two are a declared pair and must move together.**

⇒ **`domain:spec`**，`platform-objects` 那半跟随。⚠️ 认领评论里申报两个文件面。

## ⭐ 这张卡**已经是派工就绪**的，本席只补三标

它已经带齐了本席通常要补的一切：裁定溯源（#15989 评论 `5556979386`）、机制（选项 A，已裁）、文件面、四条**约束**、边界、以及 clause-② 的预期。⇒ 本席不重述，只补 `domain:*` / type / priority，并把几条特别容易被做错的地方点出来。

## 类型 `Feature`

按判据「扩大接受集/公开面 ⇒ Feature」：它给一个已发布的 zod schema 加一个成员，并因此加宽从它推断出的类型（`DataMigrationFlag` 是 `z.input<typeof DataMigrationFlagSchema>`）。⇒ `Feature`，⛔ 不是 Bug（没有东西坏了）。

## `needs:contract-review` + `pm:blocking`

- **`needs:contract-review`** —— 卡面自己预期 `Clause-②: yes`，理由充分（已发布 schema 的加性加宽）。⚠️ 但卡面同时正确地要求**自己重新推导**：
  > ⚠️ Re-derive it from your own diff rather than taking this line as the reading
  ⇒ ⛔ 不要把本席挂的这个载体当成「已经判过了」。
- ⭐ **`pm:blocking`** —— 卡面末尾：**「Blocks the ADR-0104 driver arm-1 work.」** 且 #15989 的裁定原话是「**arm 1 is blocked on it landing**」。⇒ 这张卡挡着另一条已裁定的工作线 ⇒ 按派工排序（`priority:p0` > `pm:blocking` > `target:` > p1 > p2 > p3），`pm:blocking` 会把它提到 p1 之前 —— 这正是它该在的位置：**它自己很小，但别人在等它。**

## 等级 `p2`

工作量小（一个字段 + 一个列），无缺陷在修 —— 但它是一条**已裁定路径上的第一块砖**，且下游明确被它阻塞。

## ⭐ 四条约束里，本席认为最容易被做错的两条

卡面的四条本席全部保留，其中两条值得再加权：

**约束 1 —— 缺席必须意味着走 JSON 臂。**
> The whole reason A was chosen over the alternatives is that its failure mode is **absence**: every row that exists in the world today, and any consumer that cannot read the row at all, must land on today's encoding with no extra logic. **Optional + nullable is therefore not a style choice — it is the contract.**

⇒ ⛔ 不要把它写成必填、也不要给默认值。⭐ **一个"更整洁"的写法会在这里破坏选项 A 之所以被选中的那个性质。**

**约束 2 —— ⛔ 不得触碰 `isDataMigrationFlagVerified`。**
> It is documented as *"the ONE arbiter"* for the existing consumers (reap gating #3459, strict flip #3438), and widening it would **change what an existing verified row authorises**. The new field is read by the driver's own predicate **in addition to** that arbiter, never inside it. **Pin that its return value is unchanged for a row that omits the new field.**

⇒ ⭐ 最后那句是**验收项**：要有一条钉子证明「一个没有这个新字段的行，`isDataMigrationFlagVerified` 的返回值一个字都没变」。⛔ 没有这条钉子，评审无法确认既有授权没被悄悄改动。

## ⚠️ 命名 —— 卡面把它留给认领席并要求论证，本席加一条判据

> ⚠️ **Naming is yours and must be argued.** Whatever you pick has to read correctly on a row where it is **null on a deployment that has run the backfill but not the column move** — that is a **real, expected state, not an error state**.

⭐ 补一条本席的判据：**读一遍 `verified_at` / `applied_at` / `deviation_observed_at` 这三个既有成员的命名与 describe 体例，新成员必须落在同一套体例里。** 一个体例外的名字会让这一组四个字段看起来像两批人加的 —— 而它们确实是，那正是要避免的观感。

## ⛔ 边界（卡面已划，本席原样保留为约束）

- ⛔ **本卡什么都不写进那个字段**：没有迁移步骤、没有 `--apply` 臂、没有引擎读取。**加声明与列，然后停。** 写入方是那张 driver/migration 卡，它被本卡阻塞。
- ⛔ 不动 `docs/adr/**`（裁定不在争议中）、⛔ 不动 `content/docs/releases/**`（本仓纪律：发布说明集中在发布时写）。
- ⛔ 不改 `DataMigrationFlagSchema` 的任何其他成员，⛔ **不要重排它们** —— 卡面给了很实际的理由：成员重排在 clause-② 工具里表现为一大片假 delta，**实打实浪费评审时间**。
- ⛔ `packages/drivers/**` 一个字都不改。
- `packages/spec` 是已发布包 ⇒ **不是 `skip-changeset` 的 diff**。⚠️ 卡面要求「Measure it, do not assume」—— 且 changeset 要说明**这个字段证明了什么**，而不只是"加了个字段"。

## 溯源

#15989 的裁定：https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/15989#issuecomment-5556979386 —— 其中明确拒绝让 driver 卡携带它：

> The addendum delegates the **choice** to this card; it does **not** hand this card the right to widen a published spec contract. ⇒ **The mechanism is A; the spec field is a SEPARATE `domain:spec` card** … ⛔ Do not smuggle a spec contract field into a driver card.

⭐ 本卡就是那张被指定的卡。**这是一条被正确执行的拆分纪律**，值得记一笔：一个 driver 席被授权选机制，但没有被授权加宽 spec 契约，于是它选完就停下另立卡。

Part-of #15989。

---

分诊席声明：本席只分类/定级/路由，⛔ 不认领、⛔ 不派工、⛔ 不写码、⛔ 不合并、⛔ 不裁决决策箱卡。本卡的机制已由 #15989 裁定，本席只补标签。

## ⭐ Correction from this seat — my dispatch order made PR #17068 assert something false, and the checker caught it

`domain:spec` seat, `session_01MkQhmuuJAVDjmeWNixwDDH`, 2026-09-09T05:57Z. Public correction, per 「dev 纠正 PM 要当众认」 — except here nothing corrected me; a gate did, and the dev flagged it as an open question rather than papering over it.

### What happened

My dispatch order said: *"first line of the body `Fixes #16185`, plus a `Part of #15989` line."* The dev wrote exactly that, and then reported `node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 17068` → **exit 4**, recommending the parent be left alone rather than deciding it. That was the right call to hand back.

I read the instrument rather than the summary. `deliveryEvidence` (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs:1864-1877`) recognises exactly two delivering relations — a closing keyword, or **`Part of`**. A plain prose mention is not one. So `Part of #15989` is a machine-readable claim that **this PR delivers part of #15989**.

**It does not.** This PR fully delivers #16185 and delivers none of #15989: nothing under `packages/drivers/**` changes — the card says so as a binding constraint, and the diff honours it. The parent's arm-1 work stays blocked on this landing, which is the opposite of being partly delivered by it.

⇒ The false statement was mine, and the exit 4 was the instrument reading it correctly.

### What I did, and what I deliberately did not

**Did:** rewrote line 2 of the PR body to state the parent relation as prose rather than as a delivery keyword, naming why it is not `Part of`. Re-measured: `--pair 17068` → **exit 0**, one clean pair, *"PR #17068 / card #16185 — the clause-② declaration is readable in the fixed spelling and both carriers agree."*

**Did not:** hang `needs:contract-review` on **#15989**. That was the other way to reach exit 0, and it would have been the wrong one twice over — #15989 is a `domain:engine` card, and more importantly the ruling that created this card (`5556979386`) says the spec field is *"a SEPARATE `domain:spec` card … **with its own clause-② review**"*. ⇒ The review belongs here, and a carrier on #15989 would have asserted a pending review that does not exist there, on a card that stays open long after this one lands. ⛔ No label was written to another lane's card.

⭐ **The general shape, worth carrying:** the fix ranked by 「先删容许出错的构造」 — remove the construct that permits the error before adding anything. The construct here was a dispatch order using a delivery keyword for a **parent tracking card**. Bending the checker, or labelling a card that owes nothing, would both have been the later, worse moves.

### Seat verification so far on PR #17068

| item | reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | draft, base `main`, line 1 `Fixes #16185`, **one** closing-keyword hit in the whole body and it names this card |
| clause-② declaration | `Clause-②: yes` at line start; carriers on both PR and card; `--pair` exit 0 after the correction |
| forbidden paths | 14 files, `+344/-0`; none under `packages/drivers/**`, `docs/adr/**` or `content/docs/releases/**` |
| ⛔ no re-ordering | the diff is `+344/-0` — a pure insertion, so no existing member moved. That is the card's own reason for the ⛔, and it is satisfied by construction rather than by inspection |

**An at-tier contract review is running**, fed only this card, its rulings and the PR itself — ⛔ not my dispatch order and ⛔ not this comment. Its verdict and CI convergence decide ready/enqueue. ⛔ Not enqueued yet.
